extracted.name: Cinnamon Sugar Bread Crust Treats
extracted.description: This is how you get kids - big or small - to eat their bread crusts! Tastes like cinnamon doughnuts - only crunchy and a whole lot healthier!
ingredient_lines: 6 cups bread crusts ((enough to spread out over 2 baking trays), preferably stale)
instruction_lines: Place bread crusts in a large bowl. Drizzle over butter, tossing the bread crusts as you go (with your other hand) to evenly distribute as best as possible.
Sprinkle over 4 tbsp of sugar and cinnamon, and toss through.
Bake for 5 to 8 minutes until golden brown and crunchy (check the ones in the middle of the tray). The tray on the top shelf will be ready first. The bottom tray will take a couple of minutes longer.
While hot, sprinkle over the remaining 1 tbsp of sugar (1/2 tbsp over each tray). This is mainly for appearance purpose.
